# 💳 Gmail Forward (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — the Gmail-forward subcommand of the gws CLI: forward any message by ID to one or more recipients (`gws gmail +forward --message-id <ID> --to <EMAILS>`) with an optional note above the quote, original attachments included by default (inline images preserved in HTML mode), extra file attachments, CC/BCC, send-as alias, HTML body, a 25MB combined limit, plus --dry-run and --draft modes. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: you still need the gws binary installed and authenticated, and the shared auth/security rules live in a separate gws-shared skill the agent must read first; Gmail forwarding quotas and size limits still apply. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
